provider_tool_contracts.name: datatable_data
provider_tool_contracts.description: Query, upsert, or delete datatable records.

filters.description:
Field filters dict — query, delete.
Simple: {"status__eq": "active", "salary__gte": 50000}
Logical combinators (dict keys):
  {"or":  [{"status__eq": "active"}, {"status__eq": "draft"}]}
  {"and": [{"score__gte": 8}, {"active__eq": true}]}
  {"not": {"is_deleted__eq": true}}
Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, null, nnull,
  in, nin, ina, nina (pass list),
  contains, ncontains, startswith, nstartswith, endswith, nendswith
    (case-insensitive ILIKE),
  containss, ncontainss, startswiths, nstartswiths, endswiths, nendswiths
    (case-sensitive LIKE),
  like, ilike (raw pattern with % wildcards),
  between, nbetween (pass [lower, upper] list),
  acontains, nacontains, acontainedby, nacontainedby,
    aoverlap, naoverlap, aelement, naelement (ARRAY columns),
  rcontains (@>), rcontainedby (<@), roverlaps (&&),
    radjacent (-|-), rstrictleft (<<), rstrictright (>>) (x-pg-type range columns),
  search (full-text search, e.g. {"search_vector__search": "python django"}),
  vector_near (ANN similarity search on a vector column, e.g.
    {"embedding__vector_near": [0.1, 0.2, ...]}). Tune via the
    topk / vector_metric / vector_threshold / vector_ef_search params.
    Combine with a __search filter + hybrid_strategy="rrf" for hybrid search.
FK traversal (flat_table only):
  Forward FK (INNER JOIN): {"department_id.name__contains": "Eng"}
  Reverse FK (EXISTS): {"employees.status__eq": "active"}
    Reverse rel names = child table name (e.g. "employees" on departments).
  M2M (EXISTS): {"tags.label__eq": "urgent"}  — needs manyToManyRelationships
Traversal does NOT add the related row to the response — use `populate` for that.
Range values: scalar for point-containment, [lower, upper] list for range-to-range.

ordering.description:
Comma-separated sort fields — query only.
Prefix with "-" for descending. Multi-field and FK traversal supported.
Examples: "name" | "-salary" | "department_id.name,-salary" | "department_id.name"

populate.description:
Comma-separated relationships to expand inline — query only.
Use exact FK column name: "department_id" not "department".
Dot-notation nesting: "department_id.organization_id" embeds org inside dept
  in a single request (BELONGS_TO chains, flat_table only, max depth 3).
Reverse hasMany: use child table name — e.g. "employees" on departments table.
Wildcard: "*" expands all relationships
Max depth: 3 Example: "department_id,tags"

fields.description:
Comma-separated field names to return — query only.
Omit for all fields. Example: "id,name,salary,department_id"

data.description: Single record dict or list of records — upsert only (required)

validate.description: Validate against schema (default: True) — upsert only

partial.description: Allow partial updates (default: False) — upsert only

ids.description: Single ID (int/UUID string) or list of IDs — delete only

provider_tool_contracts.name: manage_event_subscription
provider_tool_contracts.description:
Wire a serverless function to a platform event so it runs automatically
when that event fires (e.g. run a welcome-email function on POST_USER_CREATE,
or an audit function on RECORD_UPDATE). Create the function first with
manage_function, then subscribe it here.

event.description:
Event type name from the list above — required for
list_subscribers, subscribe, unsubscribe

function_slug.description:
Slug of a function in the current app — required for
subscribe, unsubscribe
